subject: general
question:
Match the geological feature with its primary plate boundary type:

1. Mid-ocean ridge

2. Mariana Trench

3. San Andreas Fault
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1: 1-Divergent, 2-Convergent, 3-Transform**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Mid-ocean ridge** is associated with **divergent plate boundaries**, where tectonic plates move apart, allowing magma to rise and form new oceanic crust. An example is the **Mid-Atlantic Ridge**.
 
• **Mariana Trench** is formed at a **convergent plate boundary**, where one tectonic plate is subducted under another. This creates deep oceanic trenches like the Mariana Trench,
